from_sql:

left join md_donvitinhsanpham dvtvt on dvtvt.md_donvitinhsanpham_id = spvt.md_donvitinhsanpham_id 
outer apply (
	select cdh. md_sanpham_id
	from md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_cdh cdh 
	where cdh.md_lenhsanxuat_id = lsx.md_lenhsanxuat_id and cdh.hoatdong =1 and cdh.md_sanpham_id = vt.md_sanpham_id
)app

and kh.c_kehoachdathang_id = '@id'
and isnull(spvt.vattu, 0) = 1
and isnull(app.md_sanpham_id,'') = ''
and vt.soluong > 0
and kh.trangthai not in ('SOANTHAO','ChoTTP','DaXLTTP', 'ChoTBTP', 'DaXLTBTP')

)

from_sql:
md_sanpham sp 
left join md_donvitinhsanpham dvt_sp on sp.md_donvitinhsanpham_id = dvt_sp.md_donvitinhsanpham_id
left join md_phanxuong px on sp.md_phanxuong_id = px.md_phanxuong_id
left join ad_department pb on pb.md_phongban_id = sp.phongbanId
left join md_phanxuong_to pxt on sp.md_to_id = pxt.md_to_id
left join md_kho kmd on sp.khomacdinh = kmd.md_kho_id
left join md_kho kton on sp.khoton = kton.md_kho_id
left join md_thue_sanpham thue on sp.md_thue_sanpham_id = thue.md_thue_sanpham_id
left join md_doitackinhdoanh dtkd on sp.nhacungung = dtkd.md_doitackinhdoanh_id
left join md_sanphamhinhdang sphd on sphd.md_sanphamhinhdang_id = sp.md_chungloai_id
left join md_chungloai cl on cl.md_chungloai_id = sp.md_nhomnangluc_id
where_sql: and isnull(sp.sanpham, 0) = 0 and isnull(sp.vattu, 0) = 1 and isnull(sp.ban_thanhpham, 0) = 1

select_sql: spvt.md_sanpham_id + cdh.xuongPhu as md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_vattu_id,pb.ten_phongban as xuongPhu,spvt.ma_sanpham as md_sanpham_id,spvt.mota_tiengviet as ten_sanpham,dvtvt.ten_dvt as md_donvitinhsanpham_id,sum(vt.soluong) as soluong,null as dangno,isnull((select sum(0-soluong_no) from md_kho_ghino where md_phanxuong_id = cdh.xuongPhu and md_sanpham_id = spvt.md_sanpham_id and soluong_no < 0), 0) as truno,sum(isnull(vt.sl_hanngach, 0)) as sl_hanngach,sum(vt.soluong) - sum(isnull(vt.sl_hanngach, 0)) as sl_giamhanngach
from_sql:
md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_vattu vt
left join md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_cdh cdh on vt.sp2 = cdh.macuoi and vt.sp3 = cdh.mathaydoi
left join ad_department pb on pb.md_phongban_id = cdh.xuongPhu
left join md_sanpham spvt on spvt.md_sanpham_id = vt.md_sanpham_id 
left join md_donvitinhsanpham dvtvt on dvtvt.md_donvitinhsanpham_id = spvt.md_donvitinhsanpham_id
where_sql:
and vt.sp1 in (select ma_sanpham from md_sanpham where md_sanpham_id = cdh.md_sanpham_id)
and cdh.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id = vt.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id
and isnull(spvt.vattu, 0) = 1
and isnull(cdh.lsxCT, '') != ''
groupby_sql: spvt.md_sanpham_id, spvt.ma_sanpham, dvtvt.ten_dvt, spvt.mota_tiengviet, cdh.xuongPhu, pb.ten_phongban

select_sql: kh.c_kehoachdathang_id + sp.md_sanpham_id as md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_dklhttp_id,sp.ma_sanpham as md_sanpham_id,dvtsp.ten_dvt as md_donvitinhsanpham_id,sum(isnull(cdh.sl_dat, 0)) - sum(isnull(cdh.sl_chiato2, 0)) as sl_lsx,sum(isnull(klhttp.sl_tonkho, 0)) as sl_tonkho,(case when kh.trangthai = 'SOANTHAO' then 0 else sum((case when len(tsx.phieulayhttp) > 1 then isnull(klhttp.sl_layton, 0) else 0 end)) end) as sl_dklt,sum(klhttp.sl_layton1) as sl_layton,sum(isnull(cdh.sl_dat, 0)) - sum(isnull(cdh.sl_chiato2, 0)) - sum(isnull(cdh.sl_nhapkho, 0)) as sl_conlai,kh.trangthai as ttkh
from_sql:
md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_dklhttp klhttp 
left join md_lenhsanxuat_tosx tsx on tsx.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id = klhttp.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id
left join md_lenhsanxuat lsx on lsx.md_lenhsanxuat_id = tsx.md_lenhsanxuat_id
left join c_kehoachdathang kh on kh.c_kehoachdathang_id = lsx.c_kehoachdathang_id
left join md_sanpham sp on klhttp.md_sanpham_id = sp.md_sanpham_id
left join md_donvitinhsanpham dvtsp on dvtsp.md_donvitinhsanpham_id  = sp.md_donvitinhsanpham_id
left join md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_cdh cdh on tsx.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id = cdh.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id and cdh.md_sanpham_id = klhttp.md_sanpham_id and cdh.macuoi = klhttp.macuoi
where_sql:
and tsx.stt = 9999 
and klhttp.sl_tonkho  > 0 
and (
	cdh.sl_dat - isnull(cdh.sl_chiato2, 0) > 0 
	or (
		len(tsx.phieulayhttp) > 1 
		and isnull(klhttp.sl_layton, 0) > 0 
	)
)
and kh.c_kehoachdathang_id = '@id'
groupby_sql: kh.c_kehoachdathang_id, kh.trangthai, sp.md_sanpham_id, sp.ma_sanpham, sp.mota_tiengviet, dvtsp.ten_dvt, kh.trangthai

select_sql: sp.md_sanpham_id + replace(isnull(cdh.lsxCT,''),'/','') as md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_cdh_id,null as md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id,sp.ma_sanpham as md_sanpham_id,sp.mota_tiengviet as mota_tiengviet,null as macuoi,sum(cdh.sl_chiato - isnull(cdh.sl_chiato2, 0) - isnull(cdh.sl_datncc, 0) - isnull(cdh.sl_datncc2, 0)) as cansx,sum( cdh.sl_dagiao ) as sl_dagiao,pb.ten_phongban as xuongPhu,cdh.lsxCT as lsxCT,dvtsp.ten_dvt as md_donvitinhsanpham_id,null as nguoitao,null as vaitrotao,null as bophantao,null as nguoicapnhat,null as vaitrocapnhat,null as bophancapnhat,null as value_nguoitao,null as value_vaitrotao,null as value_bophantao,null as value_nguoicapnhat,null as value_vaitrocapnhat,null as value_bophancapnhat,null as ngaytao,null as ngaycapnhat,null as mota,null as hoatdong
from_sql:
md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_cdh cdh
left join md_lenhsanxuat_tosx tsx on tsx.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id = cdh.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id
left join md_lenhsanxuat lsx on lsx.md_lenhsanxuat_id = tsx.md_lenhsanxuat_id
left join md_sanpham sp on sp.md_sanpham_id = cdh.md_sanpham_id
left join md_donvitinhsanpham dvtsp on dvtsp.md_donvitinhsanpham_id = sp.md_donvitinhsanpham_id
left join ad_department pb on pb.md_phongban_id = tsx.xuongPhu
left join c_kehoachdathang kh on kh.c_kehoachdathang_id = lsx.c_kehoachdathang_id
where_sql:
and lsx.c_kehoachdathang_id = '@id'
and (cdh.sl_chiato - isnull(cdh.sl_chiato2, 0) - isnull(cdh.sl_datncc, 0) - isnull(cdh.sl_datncc2, 0)) > 0
and isnull(cdh.xuongPhu,'') != ''
and kh.trangthai not in ('SOANTHAO','ChoTTP','DaXLTTP', 'ChoTBTP')
and sp.ma_sanpham like (
	case 
		when lsx.dhtron = 1 then N'%' 
		when lsx.sxton = 1 then N'%[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]%' 
		else N'%[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-%' 
	end
)
and tsx.stt = (
	case 
		when lsx.dhtron = 1 then 9997
		when lsx.sxton = 1 then 9998 
		else 9999 
	end
)
groupby_sql: sp.md_sanpham_id, sp.ma_sanpham, sp.mota_tiengviet, dvtsp .ten_dvt, pb.ten_phongban, tsx.stt, kh.trangthai, cdh.lsxCT

left join md_donvitinhsanpham dvtsp on cdh.md_donvitinhsanpham_id = dvtsp.md_donvitinhsanpham_id

and tsx.stt in (9999, 9998)

	cdh.sl_chiato - isnull(cdh.sl_chiato2, 0) - isnull(cdh.sl_datncc2, 0) > 0
	or
	isnull(cdh.sl_datncc, 0) > 0
)

select_sql: sp.md_sanpham_id + replace(isnull(cdh.lsxCT,''),'/','') as md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_cdh_id,null as md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id,sp.ma_sanpham as md_sanpham_id,null as macuoi,null as mathaydoi,sum(cdh.sl_chiato - isnull(cdh.sl_chiato2, 0) - isnull(cdh.sl_datncc, 0) - isnull(cdh.sl_datncc2, 0)) as cansx,sum(isnull(cdh.sl_danhapkho, 0)) as sl_dagiao,pb.ten_phongban as xuongPhu,isnull(cdh.lsxCT, '') as lsxCT,null as sl_dat,null as sl_dat2,sum(cdh.sl_chiato) as sl_chiato,sum(cdh.sl_nhapkho) as sl_nhapkho,null as sl_layton,null as sl_laytondu,sum( cdh.sl_dahoanthanh - isnull(cdh.sl_nhapkho, 0)) as sl_dahoanthanh,null as sl_hoanthanh,null as sl_danhapkho,null as sl_nhapkho2,null as sl_chophepnkton,null as sl_nkton,null as sl_tinhvattu,null as sl_giamhanngach,dvtsp.ten_dvt as md_donvitinhsanpham_id,null as nguoitao,null as vaitrotao,null as bophantao,null as nguoicapnhat,null as vaitrocapnhat,null as bophancapnhat,null as value_nguoitao,null as value_vaitrotao,null as value_bophantao,null as value_nguoicapnhat,null as value_vaitrocapnhat,null as value_bophancapnhat,null as ngaytao,null as ngaycapnhat,null as mota,null as hoatdong,null as nhanphoisoi,null as nhomnangluc,null as gianhancong,null as ngayhoanthanh,null as bomId,null as pbgId
from_sql:
md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_cdh cdh
left join md_lenhsanxuat_tosx tsx on tsx.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id = cdh.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id
left join md_lenhsanxuat lsx on lsx.md_lenhsanxuat_id = tsx.md_lenhsanxuat_id
left join md_sanpham sp on sp.md_sanpham_id = cdh.md_sanpham_id
left join md_donvitinhsanpham dvtsp on dvtsp.md_donvitinhsanpham_id = sp.md_donvitinhsanpham_id
left join ad_department pb on pb.md_phongban_id = tsx.xuongPhu
left join c_kehoachdathang kh on kh.c_kehoachdathang_id = lsx.c_kehoachdathang_id
where_sql:
and lsx.c_kehoachdathang_id = '@id'
and (cdh.sl_chiato - isnull(cdh.sl_chiato2, 0) - isnull(cdh.sl_datncc, 0) - isnull(cdh.sl_datncc2, 0)) > 0
and kh.trangthai not in ('SOANTHAO','ChoTTP','DaXLTTP', 'ChoTBTP')
and sp.ma_sanpham like (
	case 
		when lsx.dhtron = 1 then N'%' 
		when lsx.sxton = 1 then N'%[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]%' 
		else N'%[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-%' 
	end
)
and isnull(cdh.xuongPhu,'') != ''
and tsx.stt = (
	case 
		when lsx.dhtron = 1 then 9997
		when lsx.sxton = 1 then 9998 
		else 9999 
	end
)
groupby_sql: sp.md_sanpham_id, sp.ma_sanpham, dvtsp .ten_dvt, pb.ten_phongban, tsx.stt, isnull(cdh.lsxCT, '')

select_sql: khdh.c_kehoachdathang_id  as c_kehoachdathang_id, khdh.trangthai  as trangthai, khdh.sodonhang  as sodonhang, khdh.donhang_thamchieu  as donhang_thamchieu,dsdh.sanxuatton as donhangtru, khdh.nhomKH as nhomKH,khdh.hangiaohangPO as hangiaohangPO, khdh.ngaykehoach  as ngaykehoach, khdh.nguoitao  as nguoitao, khdh.vaitrotao  as vaitrotao, khdh.bophantao  as bophantao, khdh.nguoicapnhat  as nguoicapnhat, khdh.vaitrocapnhat  as vaitrocapnhat, khdh.bophancapnhat  as bophancapnhat, khdh.value_nguoitao  as value_nguoitao, khdh.value_vaitrotao  as value_vaitrotao, khdh.value_bophantao  as value_bophantao, khdh.value_nguoicapnhat  as value_nguoicapnhat, khdh.value_vaitrocapnhat  as value_vaitrocapnhat, khdh.value_bophancapnhat  as value_bophancapnhat, khdh.ngaytao  as ngaytao, khdh.ngaycapnhat  as ngaycapnhat, khdh.mota  as mota, khdh.hoatdong  as hoatdong,khdh.ngaybatdausx as ngaybatdausx
from_sql:
c_kehoachdathang khdh
left join c_danhsachdathang dsdh on dsdh.sochungtu = khdh.sodonhang
left join md_lenhsanxuat lsx on khdh.c_kehoachdathang_id = lsx.c_kehoachdathang_id
where_sql:
and khdh.hoatdong = 1 
and khdh.trangthai not in ('SOANTHAO','ChoTTP','DaXLTTP', 'ChoTBTP')
and (select count(1) from md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_cdh cdh where cdh.md_lenhsanxuat_id = lsx.md_lenhsanxuat_id and isnull(cdh.xuongPhu,'') != '' and  (cdh.sl_chiato - isnull(cdh.sl_chiato2, 0) - isnull(cdh.sl_datncc, 0) - isnull(cdh.sl_datncc2, 0)) > 0) > 0
orderby_sql:
(case when khdh.trangthai = 'DATHET' then 9999 else 9998 end), 
khdh.ngaykehoach desc

select_sql: sp.ma_sanpham as md_sanpham_id,sp.mota_tiengviet as mota_tiengviet,dvtsp.ten_dvt as md_donvitinhsanpham_id,sum(cdh.sl_dat) as soluong,sum(isnull(cdh.sl_giamhanngach, 0)) as sl_giamhanngach,sum(cdh.sl_dat) - sum(isnull(cdh.sl_giamhanngach, 0)) as soluong_conlai,pb.ten_phongban as phongbanId
from_sql:
md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_cdh cdh
left join md_lenhsanxuat_tosx tsx on tsx.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id = cdh.md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_id
left join md_lenhsanxuat lsx on lsx.md_lenhsanxuat_id = tsx.md_lenhsanxuat_id
left join c_kehoachdathang kh on kh.c_kehoachdathang_id = lsx.c_kehoachdathang_id
left join md_sanpham sp on cdh.md_sanpham_id = sp.md_sanpham_id
left join md_donvitinhsanpham dvtsp on cdh.md_donvitinhsanpham_id = dvtsp.md_donvitinhsanpham_id
left join ad_department pb on pb.md_phongban_id = sp.phongbanId
where_sql:
and kh.c_kehoachdathang_id = '@id'
and tsx.stt = (case when lsx.sxton = 1 then 9998 else 9999 end)
groupby_sql: cdh.md_sanpham_id, sp.ma_sanpham, sp.mota_tiengviet, dvtsp.ten_dvt, lsx.sxton, pb.ten_phongban

from_sql:
md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_vattu vt
left join md_lenhsanxuat_tosx_cdh cdh on vt.sp2 = cdh.macuoi and vt.sp3 = cdh.mathaydoi
left join md_lenhsanxuat2 lsx2 on lsx2.sochungtu = cdh.lsxCT
left join md_sanpham spvt on spvt.md_sanpham_id = vt.md_sanpham_id 
left join md_donvitinhsanpham dvtvt on dvtvt.md_donvitinhsanpham_id = spvt.md_donvitinhsanpham_id
where_sql:
and lsx2.md_lenhsanxuat2_id = '@id'
and vt.sp1 in (select ma_sanpham from md_sanpham where md_sanpham_id = cdh.md_sanpham_id)
